text:
mia: Incoming ticket from cust via support form — CSV/API usage export missing Mar 3-5 for account acct_876. Invoice shows tokens for those days. Ticket #3102 attached export file.

raj: can you paste the ticket body and export file head? curious if tokens=0 rows or completely absent days.

mia: ticket snippet:
"We noticed our CSV export only has rows for 2026-03-01..2026-03-02, then jumps to 2026-03-06. Dashboard shows activity on 3/3-3/5 and invoice includes charges. CSV/API export seems to skip those dates."
Attached file preview:
```
date,project_id,requests,tokens
2026-03-01,proj_99,12,14500
2026-03-02,proj_99,8,9800
2026-03-06,proj_99,10,12000
```

simon: thanks. first hypothesis: backfill job failed for 3/3-3/5. checking aggregation logs now. Job id: agg-20260307-42

ops-bot: deploy:usage-aggregator v2.3.1 rolled at 2026-03-07T04:12Z (ci-build 654). No error alerts on deploy.

simon: logs show `ERROR: partition not found for date 2026-03-04` at 2026-03-07T05:03Z. Looks like ETL skipped creating daily partitions when source S3 bucket had a transient 503. Backfill should be possible.

elena: I attempted a repro via API export endpoint `/v1/usage/export?start=2026-03-01&end=2026-03-10&format=csv` and got same CSV (missing 3/3-3/5). Confirmed reproduce locally.

raj: invoice vs dashboard mismatch — billing service uses consolidated token aggregator, not CSV export. So charges coming from ingested events that were in DB but not in partitioned summary table. We need to rebuild summary table for that account/date range and re-run export.

simon: plan: 1) run partition backfill for 2026-03-03..2026-03-05 (job backfill-partitions agg-20260307-42 --dates 2026-03-03,2026-03-04,2026-03-05) 2) re-run csv export lambda 3) verify counts vs invoice. I'll enqueue backfill now.

simon: kicked backfill job (id backfill-1718923499). ETA ~ 7m per day due to KV cache warmups.

mia: relaying to customer: "we're running a backfill now; your invoice is correct; CSV export will be updated shortly and we'll attach a corrected file". Customer asked for provisional per-day tokens if possible.

raj: I can pull provisional per-day tokens from billing consolidated view: query run and attached quick numbers: ["2026-03-03: 4,200 tokens", "2026-03-04: 3,800 tokens", "2026-03-05: 5,100 tokens"]. Sending to customer as Temp data.

ops-bot: job backfill-1718923499 status: completed. duration 00:16:42. rows inserted: 3 (one per day).

simon: re-ran export endpoint, now CSV includes the missing rows. sample:
```
2026-03-03,proj_99,5,4200
2026-03-04,proj_99,4,3800
2026-03-05,proj_99,6,5100
```

mia: I'll upload corrected CSV to ticket and mark P1 -> resolved once customer confirms. cc @raj for invoice note.

raj: recommend we add retry logic for partition creation when S3 5xx occurs, and add monitoring alert for missing consecutive-day exports >1 day. Filed infra task INFRA-842.

simon: noted. Also adding idempotent backfill runbook to internal runbooks docs.

mia: customer replied: "Thanks — CSV looks correct now. Appreciate the quick fix :tada:". closing ticket in 24h if no further issues.
